name: Evals — Generative model (data_source.model)
summary: The model that *generates* completions to be evaluated in an eval run, specified via `data_source.model` on POST /v1/evals/{id}/runs.
description: OpenAI eval runs can use `data_source.model` when `data_source.type` is `responses` or `completions` to generate candidate outputs before grading. That generator model slot is separate from the judge deployment and would need to preserve `{connection}/{deployment}` for BYOM-routed eval generation.
notes:
The eval-run create call accepts `data_source.model = '{conn}/{deployment}'` without SDK-side URL-shape errors, but the eval service returns 404 for the just-created run so we cannot verify end-to-end generation. See `test.py`.

> Live probe on 2026-07-16 against `ai-foundry-3swd46vd3j22a`: `aoai.evals.runs.create(eval_id, data_source={'type':'responses','model':'{apim-conn}/gpt-4o-mini', ...})` returns HTTP 404 `Run evalrun_… was not found` from `http://run-history.vienna-westus3.svc/history/v1.0/…/runs/evalrun_…/events`.

The eval service accepted the BYOM prefix but a downstream Foundry service (run-history) 404s on the same run id it just created. This looks like a service race, not a BYOM rejection — but end-to-end verification is blocked until that race is fixed.

OpenAI evals are scheduled to become read-only on 2026-10-31 and shut down on 2026-11-30; Foundry evaluations are a separate product but expose the same conceptual dual-model shape.
